user.title: Cisco Mobility Express controller

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your controller, for example 192.168.10.150.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off if the controller uses a self-signed certificate.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the controller is asked for its clients, in seconds (30–300). Increase it on large setups to reduce the load on the controller.
data_description.ssl: Connect over HTTPS. Turn off if the controller only accepts HTTP or uses old TLS settings.

user.description: Connect to a Cisco Mobility Express or WLC controller. Every wireless client becomes a device tracker, disabled until you enable it.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The controller at {host} rejected the stored credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the controller

init.title: Cisco Mobility Express options

data_description.scan_interval: How often the controller is asked for its clients, in seconds (30–300). Each poll also reads the client list for the ip, ipv4 and SSID attributes. Increase it on large setups to reduce the load on the controller.
data_description.stale_tracker_age: How many days disabled MAC entities stay available. Disabled trackers of clients not seen for this many days are deleted (1–60). They are recreated, disabled, when the client connects again.

init.description: Settings that limit the load on the controller. Changes apply immediately, without a restart.

ipv6.name: IPv6 addresses
ipv6.description: Only used on a full WLC; on Mobility Express these settings have no effect.

data_description.all_ipv6: Off (default): the ipv6 attribute only holds an IPv6-only client's address from the client list. On: each client's detail page is also read for all its IPv6 addresses, including link-local. That costs one extra request per client, so leave it off on large setups unless you need it.
data_description.ipv6_polling_interval: How often each client's detail page is read for its IPv6 addresses, in minutes (1–15). Only used when Fetch all IPv6 addresses is on.
